subject: Re: Request: Demo access while PO processes
messages:
From: Anna Liu <anna@greenfieldlabs.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenfieldlabs.com
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Demo access while PO processes

Hi Nikhil,

Quick note from procurement side — our PO for Redwood is routed through a third-party approver this week and it looks like approval will slip past the demo end date. The engineering team still needs the sandbox to run the integration tests through next week to complete validation.

Can you hold the demo environment active for an extra 10 calendar days while we get signatures in place? If it helps, I attached the current PO draft so you can see where we are. We really value the progress and don't want the timer to interrupt the pilots.

Thanks,
Anna Liu
Head of Platform Integrations
Greenfield Labs

Attachments: PO_Draft_Greenfield.pdf (application/pdf, 84 KB)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Liu <anna@greenfieldlabs.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Demo access while PO processes

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the PO draft. We can absolutely help keep your evaluation from stalling.

Immediate options I can offer today (while I loop in Ops/Finance for a recorded concession):
- Place the sandbox on a 10-day extension tied to the PO draft reference number (no new charges during the extension).
- If you need uninterrupted performance for the test window, we can provision a small temporary credit package (up to 200k tokens) to cover burst usage; that avoids having us make any long-lived billing changes.

Can you confirm the expected PO signature date? If the sign-off slips past 10 days, we can escalate a follow-up but prefer to keep this as a limited goodwill concession.

I'll run the proposal by David for approval and copy back once Ops has recorded it.

—Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Anna Liu <anna@greenfieldlabs.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenfieldlabs.com
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Demo access while PO processes

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks — procurement is targeting next Thursday (2027-06-10) for final internal sign-off, but there is a small chance it slips to Friday. The draft I attached should be what your finance team needs to reconcile.

Given the importance of the integration tests, a 10-day extension would be perfect. If you can mark the extension to be voided once the PO is processed, that would be ideal — we don't want long-term credits hanging if the PO completes.

Appreciate the quick help.

Anna

Subject: Fwd: Request: Demo access while PO processes — approval needed

Team — forwarding Greenfield's request. Procurement expects sign-off on 2027-06-10 but there's a small chance of a further day delay. Proposed concession: grant the 10-calendar-day demo extension tied to the PO draft (GF-PO-0427) and record a token-limited temporary credit (200k tokens) in case they ramp tests unexpectedly. No long-term billing changes; auto-revoke on PO completion.

Why: preserves momentum on a high-potential integration (engineering already completed 60% of the validation tests).

Can I get approval to proceed with the 10-day extension + token buffer? If approved, I'll confirm to Anna and add the concession note to HubSpot (link below).

Proposal attached: extension_proposal_nikhil.pdf

—Nikhil

Attachments: extension_proposal_nikhil.pdf

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Demo access while PO processes — approval needed

Approved.
- Grant the 10-calendar-day extension tied to PO draft GF-PO-0427.
- Provision a temporary token credit up to 200,000 tokens; set to expire on the earlier of: (a) PO processed or (b) 30 days from today.
- Record the concession in HubSpot (deal GF-2027-089) and attach the PO draft + our extension proposal.

Nikhil — please confirm to Anna and ask them to share the DocuSign link or final PO when available. Camila/Vanessa, please update the account notes and mark this as a "concession: demo extension" so renewals sees it later.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
